tools.name: sap_pm_get_equipment
tools.description: Retrieve SAP PM equipment master data (description, functional location, object type, manufacturer, serial number, warranty dates) by equipment ID or a fuzzy equipment nickname/functional location string, so an unresolved technician reference can be matched to a canonical Equipment ID before a notification is drafted.

equipment_id.description: Canonical SAP PM Equipment ID, e.g. 10004555.

search_text.description: Free-text equipment nickname to fuzzy-match, e.g. 'Motor07 line5'.

tools.name: sap_pm_search_notifications_orders
tools.description: Query open and recent SAP PM maintenance notifications and work orders for a given equipment ID within a lookback window, used for duplicate-submission detection before drafting a new notification and for shift-end order-status aggregation.

tools.name: sap_pm_stage_notification
tools.description: Stage a draft SAP PM maintenance notification (breakdown or observed issue) for human review. This does NOT write to SAP PM — it returns a confirmation payload with a staging ID that must be explicitly approved via sap_pm_commit_write before any record is created, per the mandatory human-review gate in this use case's Technical Design.

tools.name: sap_pm_stage_work_order_confirmation
tools.description: Stage a completion confirmation (labor hours, parts consumed) against an existing SAP PM work order for human review. This does NOT write to SAP PM — it returns a staging ID that must be explicitly approved via sap_pm_commit_write before the confirmation is posted, per the mandatory human-review gate.

tools.name: sap_pm_commit_write
tools.description: Commit a previously staged notification, work order, or completion confirmation to SAP PM via OData POST/PATCH with an idempotency key. Requires an explicit human approver identity; must never be called without a logged approval event tied to a specific reviewer (FR-8/FR-9). Writes an audit record (approver identity, timestamp, payload hash) on success.

approved_by.description: Identity of the human reviewer who approved this write.

tools.name: sap_pm_get_breakdown_history
tools.description: Retrieve breakdown/downtime history (MTBF, MTTR, downtime hours, cost) for an equipment ID from the PM Info System, used sparingly to note recurring-failure context in a completion report's root-cause narrative.
